# partitions/spec.txt - Plugin Partition policy (Extended)
# (Ref: OpenWindows-Storage; libowfs.a = OWFS, libusfs.a = USFS.)

A SuperUnicode Plugin Partition is created on FIRST VALID BOOT of a
staged plugin, after the boot checksum gate:

  stage install  ->  reboot REQUIRED (SUCS_PLUGIN_REBOOT_REQUIRED)
  boot commit    ->  CRC32c + Fletcher-64 verify
                     -> mount as SuperUnicode Plugin Partition
                     -> register codepoint ranges into ExtSUCS

FORMATS
  OWFS ONLY. USFS is NEVER accepted for a plugin partition.

POLICY
  Always read-only. Quarantined (gate-failed) plugins are never mounted
  and never register ranges.

  Base SUCS partitions (bugfix/rescue) MAY be OWFS or USFS and live in
  the Base tree: superunicode/Public/<version>/partitions/spec.txt.
